items.title: anatomy
items.description: An agent skill for creating detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of real-world machines and complex systems. Generates polished SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects.
items.summary: Anatomy is a skill for Anthropic's Claude Code that turns technical ideas into detailed, interactive isometric figures of real machines. It generates SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects for documentation, articles, and landing pages. The figures can be delivered in several forms, including standalone HTML pages, single SVG files, or React/Next.js components, in either light or dark themes. The skill is installed via a CLI or git and requires a recent Node.js version. The project is hosted on GitHub under the repository wheresryan22/anatomy, licensed under MIT.

items.title: talorys
items.description: Your personal AI agent in your own Cloudflare account. Chat, memory, tasks, notes and scheduled reminders, deployed with one command: npx create-talorys@latest. Free-tier friendly, single-user, no telemetry.
items.summary: Talorys is a free, open-source personal AI agent that deploys entirely into a user's own Cloudflare account via a single npx command. It offers chat, memory, tasks, notes, projects, and scheduled reminders, running on Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Durable Objects with Workers AI for inference. The architecture keeps the agent Worker private via a service binding, with authentication handled. The deployment command is `npx create-talorys@latest`, and it uses SQLite for storage. The project is designed to fit the Cloudflare free tier with no servers or accounts operated by the developers. There is no telemetry or third-party backend operated by the developers, and the data stays under the user's control.

items.title: esp32-iphone-agent
items.description: Let an AI model use a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32: AirPlay eyes, USB HID hands, any OpenAI-compatible vision model. No Mac, no developer account, no jailbreak.
items.summary: The ESP32-iPhone-Agent project enables AI models to interact with the physical world using an iPhone as the primary interface, leveraging an ESP32 microcontroller for hardware control and an iPhone for camera input (via AirPlay mirroring) and output (via USB HID for simulated touch inputs). Any OpenAI-compatible vision model can be used, allowing for diverse AI applications without requiring a Mac, developer account, or jailbreaking the iPhone. The system has three main parts: the AI model, the ESP32 microcontroller, and the iPhone. The AI model interprets visual data and makes decisions, the ESP32 connects the digital AI to the physical iPhone, and the iPhone supplies the visual input through its camera.

items.title: Tracely-ai
items.summary: Tracely is an open-source platform that turns production failures of AI agents into regression tests by ingesting agent traces over OTLP, grading each run with structural checks and LLM judges, and allowing promotion of failing traces into hermetic test cases replayed on every pull request. It supports auto-instrumentation for various AI agents and offers a Python SDK for easy integration. The platform emphasizes "the recorded run is the test" and provides a straightforward interface for tracing and monitoring AI model interactions.

items.title: ff-tracking
items.description: A virtual camera films an AI agent's screen while a tracker locks onto every glyph. Two fframes passes, one SkSL shader, all sound synthesized.

items.description: 麦麦省钱助手 —— 基于麦当劳 MCP 的点餐成本优化 Skill。算出当前门店最省钱的点餐方案，并主动提示凑单陷阱。
items.summary: To optimize your meal cost at McDonald's, consider the following strategies based on the sources: for new customers, joining the rewards program and checking for first-order discounts can be beneficial. For regular breakfast orders, the "buy one get one for a dollar" deal is flexible and cost-effective. For a low-cost lunch or dinner, combo meals including sandwiches, fries, drinks, and chicken pieces are generally more economical than ordering items separately. items.title: Reverse-Engineer-anything
items.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
items.summary: To reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries, use the REA tool by Morluto. The setup is `npx rea-agents setup`, which edits config files, backs up existing configurations, and pre-selects agents with REA registration. The tool supports twelve agents and requires Node 22.19+. For a quick start without setup, point it at an extracted Electron or JavaScript app tree and run `npx -y rea-agents@latest analyze-javascript-application [absolute-path] --json`. This returns four fields: evidence, a recovered graph, limitations, and unknowns.

items.title: RoboHarness
items.description: A robotic harness that gives LLM agents a visual-geometric control panel so that they can directly understand and invoke embodied tasks.
items.summary: RoboHarness is a robotic harness that provides LLM agents with a visual-geometric control panel to directly understand and invoke embodied tasks. It involves cutting-edge embodied AI robotics research, spatial-geometric control integration, and evaluating on complex robotic manipulation benchmarks. The harness connects foundation vision-language models to robots through a compact semantic action interface, supporting zero-shot control with frontier VLMs and lightweight fine-tuning of small open-source models. It has been used to achieve impressive real-world tasks such as folding a unique low shirt and cutting a slice of cake with a robot.

items.title: AgentGarten
items.description: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents
items.summary: AgentGarten is a framework that builds real-time interactive environments by coupling simulators and game engines with a shared neural renderer. These environments are both simulators and game engines that maintain persistent state and execute program-defined rules, while a shared neural renderer generates the agent's observations from the depth and surface normals each world exports. Agents practice in these environments and improve from their own experience by distilling what happened into playbooks that later agents inherit and build upon. The neural renderer adapts Cosmos3-Nano to geometry conditions in three stages, and the framework aims to create environments that are both faithful and realistic, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and observations that follow the real-world visual distributions.

items.title: Imei-Repair
items.description: Imei Repair Free is an AI-driven software that empowers users to swiftly and securely manage their device's IMEI number information without any...
items.summary: The sources indicate that IMEI repair involves restoring or rewriting the International Mobile Equipment Identity number stored in a device’s baseband memory, typically addressing cases where the IMEI reads `000000000000000`, `NULL`, or is entirely blank. It is not synonymous with unlocking, jailbreaking, or bypassing Google FRP. The sources caution against using third-party apps for IMEI changes as they often inject malware and cannot write to baseband memory. Instead, they recommend verified, vendor-agnostic tools like ChimeraTool or Cheetah Tool for devices with functional bootloader access and specific chipsets. The IMEI Changer app for Android is free and published by Fantastic Fun, but the sources do not provide details on its functionality or safety.

items.title: podcast-to-article
items.description: 把多人对谈播客的逐字稿整理成可发布长文的 Agent Skill：换轴成文、人名校准、精简三分之一、去 AI 味自检。An agent skill that turns podcast transcripts into publishable articles.
items.summary: The agent skill "podcast-to-article" transforms podcast transcripts into publishable articles by changing the axis from speaker and time to topic and judgment. It follows three rules: removing speaker's framework, retaining factual granularity, and preserving original speech tone. The tool was tested on a 5730-character transcript, which was reduced to 3703 characters, a 35% reduction. The process includes seven steps: cleaning the transcript, summarizing key points, defining the main line, changing the axis to use original text, correcting names, simplifying, and self-checking. The tool is entirely in Python and has no platform dependencies.

items.title: pub-street-fighter-ai
items.description: Ultimate SFighterAI
items.summary: The project "pub-street-fighter-ai" by LYiHub on GitHub aims to train a convolutional neural network model using deep reinforcement learning to play through all 12 stages of "Street Fighter II: Special Champion Edition." The model, named NatureCNN, is trained using the PPO algorithm and the character Ryu, making decisions based solely on the game's visual input. The model's input is a processed game screen of size 84×84×3, and it has a discrete action space of 27 actions. The reward system is based on health changes, with additional rewards for defeating opponents and penalties for taking damage. The project provides a trained model and instructions for testing its performance through various command-line options.

This extension works locally, with no tokens used outside the machine, and supports features like smart read/write/edit tools, sub agents, and theming. To use it, you need to install the Claude Code CLI via `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`, log in with your Claude subscription using `claude login`, and manage sessions from the VsAgentic Sessions panel. items.title: SuperNav
items.description: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
items.summary: SuperNav is an agentic navigation system that uses a pretrained multimodal model to solve diverse navigation tasks through tool use, task-progress tracking, and context management, without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the model. It enables a pretrained Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to interpret requests, understand scenes, and make navigation decisions without navigation-specific fine-tuning, while delegating motion execution to external tools. The system supports sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments, outperforming four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. It also demonstrates applicability through category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot.

items.title: yobiru
items.description: Let your agents talk: messages, data, files and wake-ups over Tailscale.
items.summary: Yobiru allows agents to communicate over a Tailscale network, facilitating direct messaging, data transfer, and file sharing between computers on the network. It operates without a central account or storage, relying on each device's own records. Devices can send messages by default, but users can restrict access through Tailscale policies. Yobiru is open source and runs on Tailscale, emphasizing security and user control over communication and wake-up settings. Tailscale itself is a tool that enables secure, encrypted connections between devices, available on multiple platforms and facilitating easy access to AI agent machines.

items.title: bug-bounty-triage
items.description: Agent skill for rigorous bug bounty report triage, validation, severity escalation, and submission-ready reporting.
items.summary: The sources describe `bug-bounty-triage` as an agent skill for rigorous bug bounty report triage, validation, severity escalation, and submission-ready reporting. It is an open-source AI skill for coding assistants, built by Sequester-AG, with 121 GitHub stars. The skill is designed to help with triaging incoming bug bounty reports, including reviewing report quality, validating findings, assessing potential impact, and routing reports to the appropriate teams. Additionally, it is used in conjunction with AI triage agents to handle bug bounty reports efficiently, as demonstrated by Elastic Security Labs' experience with HackerOne reports.

items.title: autonomous-pentest-agent
items.description: Autonomous Pentest Agent — LLM multi-agent autonomous penetration testing system (Go backend + Next.js UI). AGPL-3.0.
items.summary: The Autonomous Pentest Agent is an AI-driven multi-agent penetration testing system that uses specialized agents to cover all critical phases of penetration testing, including reconnaissance, vulnerability analysis, and exploitation. The system emulates the workflow of human red teams and ensures modularity across tasks. The PentestAgent adopts RAG-grounded, role-based collaboration to reduce hallucinations and improve next-step selection. Additionally, VulnBot structures collaboration via a Penetration Task Graph (PTG) to preserve phase order and constrain branching. The system reported results include 30.3% overall and 69.05% subtask completion on AutoPenBench and strong performance on AI-Pentest-Benchmark. In February 2026, Simbian announced the launch of the Simbian AI Pentest Agent, which provides ongoing, on-demand penetration testing and incorporates business context to ensure findings are focused on specific security risks and priorities.

items.title: cli
items.description: Official Excalidraw CLI for humans and agents
items.summary: The sources indicate that the official Excalidraw CLI is available as `mcp-excalidraw-server` or `excalidraw-canvas` and can be installed globally using `npm i -g mcp-excalidraw-server`. The CLI provides various commands for managing Excalidraw, such as `add`, `query`, `describe`, `screenshot`, `export`, `import`, `mermaid`, `snapshot`, `arrange`, and `share`. The tool is designed to offer programmatic control over Excalidraw, with real-time canvas synchronization and the ability to auto-start the canvas server if it isn't running. The sources do not provide a direct installation command for `@agent-canvas/cli`, but it is available on GitHub and npm.

items.title: wx-bot
items.description: 把微信接入你的 AI Agent（Grok / Muse / Claude 等）· Connect WeChat to your personal AI agent via official iLink
items.summary: The sources indicate that wx-bot is an open-source AI agent skill designed to connect WeChat to various AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex CLI, and ChatGPT. It allows WeChat messages to be routed to agents via webhook or pull methods, and supports text, images, voice, files, and videos. For GitHub-based integration, users are guided to clone the repository and follow specific instructions to set it up. For other AI agents, a direct command to use wx-bot is provided, which automates the setup process. The sources do not provide specific details on the safety of using wx-bot beyond mentioning it is available on GitHub with 120 stars.

items.title: justin-sun-alan-shao-ai-notes
items.description: 孙宇晨 × 邵艾伦 4 小时对谈：全文 + 精华 + 一键丢给 AI 的规划 prompt
items.summary: The sources provide details on a 4-hour discussion between Justin Sun and Alan Shao, focusing on AI integration into daily life and business strategies. The discussion includes practical steps for AI adoption, such as using AI to manage daily routines, leveraging free AI tools for personal development, and employing AI for health and fitness tracking. The sources also mention the use of AI for research, comparing different AI tools, and exploring global business opportunities. The content emphasizes the importance of AI in modern life and business, highlighting specific tools and methodologies for effective AI utilization.

items.title: pullboard
items.description: Autonomous development for real products. Agents build from the spec you approve, and nothing ships until another agent proves it.
items.summary: Autonomous development for real products involves agents building from specifications approved by users, ensuring nothing ships until another agent proves it. Tembo's approach emphasizes PR review best practices and control over changes made by agents. The 2026 AI Agent Stack by Eric Roby highlights the importance of governance and security, advocating for a minimal start with layers added only when failures are obvious. Factory's autonomous engineering system powered by Droid focuses on policy at each stage of development, ensuring standards are met before shipping fixes to users.

items.title: whooper-2.0
items.description: Your WHOOP recovery, sleep and training coach — authenticated ChatGPT and Codex plugin
items.summary: The sources indicate that Whoop data can be connected to and read by ChatGPT through the Wellness Project, which acts as an intermediary plugin. There is no direct Whoop MCP server or plugin from Whoop itself; instead, Wellness Project facilitates the connection. This setup allows recovery, sleep, and workout data from Whoop to be accessed by ChatGPT. However, Whoop's own branded recovery percentage does not cross through this connection.

items.title: work-humanizer
items.description: A humanizer for work writing: takes the AI tone out without changing what your text says or commits to. Agent Skill + evidence: blind judges, hand-checked meaning changes, Pangram.
items.summary: An AI humanizer is a tool that rewrites AI-generated text to make it sound more natural and engaging, without changing the original meaning. Grammarly’s AI humanizer uses advanced AI to analyze text and rewrite it in a human-like way. Pangram describes humanizers as tools that rewrite AI-generated text to evade AI detectors, though they note that humanizers can degrade text and add risks. WriteHuman describes an AI humanizer as a tool that rewrites text produced by AI models like ChatGPT or Gemini to sound like it was drafted by a person, keeping the original meaning intact.
